answer.rationale: Incumbent refusal blocks renew/negotiate as paths to the mandated 18% spend cut; deferral is unsafe because this is primary supply, the contract does not auto-renew in 14 days, and the line has no buffer (c5 was non-critical only). c2 is the only inherited path that actually cut unit cost with reportedly quick onboarding, so it is the current TCO-minimizing option if delivery risk does not rise. That last-year result may not hold on a 94%-loaded line in 14 days, and c1 says incumbent renewal avoided migration and delivery interruption—so verify those two records before commit and do not broad-rollout.
